items.title: Sweet Williams Interview
items.q: Me, Moran, and Horace Malcolm. You were drafted? ... Horace Malcolm, me, Moran, we were all around the same.

ctx.x: I thought the depression ended in 1935, but it continued. 35? It just started.
Yeah. 41, the war broke out. In the 40s. In the 40s. I was registered in the 40s. First draft in the 120. Me, Moran, and Horace Malcolm. You were drafted?
